panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 2 panels (A, B). A: Panel A is an ALK immunostain showing diffuse nuclear and cytoplasmic positivity, a key diagnostic feature for systemic ALK-positive anaplastic large cell lymphoma. B: Panel B is a MUM1 immunostain showing nuclear positivity, which supports the diagnosis of systemic ALK-positive anaplastic large cell lymphoma presented in the article.

plate_findings.evidence: Large, atypical cells seen in solid sheets

panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 4 panels (A, B, C, D). A: H&E stain showing classic presentation of large atypical cells in solid sheets, consistent with Systemic ALK-positive anaplastic large cell lymphoma. B: CD3 IHC showing membranous positivity of the neoplastic cells, supporting lymphoma diagnosis. C: CD20 IHC staining is negative, which is often the case for ALK-positive anaplastic large cell lymphoma. D: CD30 IHC staining showing strong membranous and Golgi complex immunoreactivity, which is a characteristic feature in ALK-positive anaplastic large cell lymphoma.

panels.figure_caption: Photomicrographs of the biopsy. A – Large, atypical cells seen in solid sheets showing nuclear indentation, vesicular chromatin, prominent nucleoli and moderate basophilic to eosinophilic cytoplasm (H&E; x200); B – CD3 immunostain showing membranous positivity of variable intensity (x200); C – CD20 immunostain is negative (x200), D - CD30 displays strong membranous and golgi complex immunoreactivity (x200).
in_text_mentions: The biopsy’s histology revealed large, atypical cells in solid sheets with a round to oval irregular nuclei and nuclear indentations (Figure 2A). The chromatin was coarse to vesicular with prominent nucleoli and moderate basophilic to eosinophilic cytoplasm. Amidst these large cells, the characteristic hallmark cells with kidney-shaped nuclei were also present. Mitotic activity was brisk. These neoplastic cells were invading and replacing the surrounding bone trabeculae, indicated by dead bony fragments, collection of giant osteoclast cells, and reactive bone formation.
